main_result.title: A sign-certified warm-root cache plus safeguarded piecewise-linear jump reduced exact water-filling endpoint query work by about 90% in local randomized validation while preserving decision-relevant endpoints to sub-picounit agreement with V2.

implementation.change: Keep the V2 immutable sorted-run envelope, cache only sign-certified root brackets for m values under the current envelope, clear the cache on append, and use a safeguarded local linear root candidate inside ordinary midpoint bracketing.

correctness_argument: For a frozen envelope, the water-filling score S(c) is continuous and nonincreasing; each cached solve stores lo with S(lo)>=mW and hi with S(hi)<=mW.
A cache entry for a smaller m gives a safe upper-c bound for a larger m; a cache entry for a larger m gives a safe lower-c bound for a smaller m.

The piecewise-linear jump is attempted only inside that safe bracket and is accepted early only under a stricter residual tolerance; otherwise the sign-certified bracket is updated and midpoint bisection still guarantees progress.
Any append changes the envelope and invalidates all cached root brackets immediately.
main_result.inherited_results: The predecessor checkpoint remains the full record for V2 storage compaction, the original exact predictable-weight envelope, fail-closed interrupted-block endpoint design, informative-size estimand separation, and predictable-weight versus off-policy boundary.

measurement_validity_rules: The warm-root change is computational only; it does not alter the predictable-weight estimand, e-process family, mixture weights, alpha threshold, or statistical assumptions.
Do not call the local timing reduction a deployment speedup; only the _stats-call reduction and tested numerical agreement are architecture-independent observations from this prototype.
Do not claim bit-for-bit internal equality with V2; use endpoint/residual/decision agreement and the independent event-sweep reference as the validation contract.
Root caches must never survive append or any other envelope mutation.
scope_guards: No forbidden semantic inputs were read.
All repository writes were confined to the evaluation role-local state/output namespace.
No public-source result was needed for this computational continuation, so no external claim is being generalized.

frontier.action: Run prefix-by-prefix streaming regression with endpoint queries after repeated appends to stress cache invalidation, then keep V3 only if endpoint/residual/decision agreement remains fail-closed.
Implement the fail-closed planned-slot interruption monitor with durable pre-admission and recovery-after-deadline semantics.
Implement the matched OPE-versus-predictable-weight synthetic comparison only where targets are mathematically identical, plus a wrong-target realized-weight counterexample.
Add a simultaneous decision rule for equal-process and planned-exposure channels with explicit joint error budgeting.
Continue public repeated-inference trace search for token-to-score/sign propagation.

exact_next_action: Stress V3 in a true streaming prefix regime where endpoint queries are interleaved with appends, verify that every append invalidates stale root brackets and preserves V2 endpoint/threshold decisions, then proceed to the planned-slot interruption monitor if the regression passes.
